For one thing, Unity's Rook City hat has a different color font, so it's not Mr. Fixer's hat. Lastly Mr. Fixer was frozen to preserve his body until the world needed him the most.

 

All saiyans wear scouters after they had defeated the Truffles on Planet Vegeta and started to use their technology. Also Freeza and his men also started to wear them after they had enslaved the saiyans. There are countless people out there that are wearing scouters, so Tachyon is very unlikely going to be Vegeta. Especially considering Vegeta no long needs to wear a scouter as he can sense people's power level. Not to mention Tachyon is way too smart to be a a full blooded saiyan.

 

Now I do not support that the new Wraith is the Operative, for obvious reasons such as the missing tattoo and the fact she is using the weapons in the opposite hands that the Operative was using them in. I more simple reasoning behind the weapons is that she was held captive by The Organization and had to fight her way out. She was able to defeat the Operative and stole her weapons to aid in her escape since she was unarmed. Now that is just all speculation on my behalf.
